commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.capability_belief_hidden_integration --dataset-npz runs/m151_capability_belief_dataset_multiseed/capability_belief_dataset.npz --optimization-seeds 9610,9611,9612 --train-fraction 0.70 --steps 300 --batch-size 64 --learning-rate 0.0003 --weight-decay 0.001 --hidden-size 128 --history-window 25 --feature-source response_hidden --delta-loss-coef 0.5 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m153_capability_belief_hidden_integration_smoke
commands.name: m153_capability_belief_hidden_integration_smoke

decision_rule: Proceed beyond integration smoke only if the capability-belief objective is wired to recurrent driver features without actor-input leakage and if behavior/intervention gates remain explicitly required before PPO promotion.
failure_criteria: hidden parameters or hidden diagnostics become deployable actor inputs
capability targets replace the policy action objective without a behavior-retention guard
implementation starts broad PPO before a small integration smoke and contract tests
M152 target and delta loss accounting is dropped
hypothesis: The M152 capability-belief objective can be attached to the recurrent driver training path as a training-time auxiliary belief head while preserving the P0 human-view actor input contract.
success_criteria: add a config-gated capability-belief auxiliary path or hidden-state objective harness
prove actor observations remain current P0 human-view deployable fields only
run a small smoke that reports capability target and pairwise delta losses
keep PPO or driver promotion blocked until behavior retention and wrong-history gates run
document whether the integration is ready for guarded PPO continuation
